title: Speculative Conditional Hypotheses: amennyiben, abban az esetben, ha; azzal a feltétellel, hogy

sections.title: Conditions You Know
sections.content: You know *amennyiben* ('if, in the event that') and *abban az esetben, ha* ('in the event that') from B2 Unit 7: both state a condition more formally than plain *ha*, and the main clause often continues with *úgy* ('then'). You also know *azzal a feltétellel, hogy* ('on the condition that') from B2 Culture Unit 7, where *azzal* points ahead to the *hogy* clause. This lesson uses them to talk about forecasts and tests: what must be true before a new machine can start.

sections.title: Real and Doubtful Conditions
sections.content: A condition that can really come true takes the plain present: *Amennyiben a kísérlet sikerül, úgy ...* For a condition you doubt, use the conditional you know (-na/-ne): *Abban az esetben, ha a gép elromlana, ...* The new words of the lesson name the things such a text talks about: *feltétel* (condition), *hipotézis*, *előrejelzés* (forecast) and *kísérlet* (experiment).

sections.title: Conditions for Forecasts and Tests
rows: Amennyiben a gép jól működik, úgy elkezdhetjük a kísérletet. (If the machine works well, we can begin the experiment.)
Abban az esetben, ha a gép elromlana, a tudósok leállítanák a kísérletet. (In the event that the machine broke down, the scientists would stop the experiment.)
A tudós azzal a feltétellel dolgozik, hogy a gép biztonságos. (The scientist works on the condition that the machine is safe.)
A hipotézis akkor marad érvényes, ha az új adatok is igazolják. (The hypothesis stays valid if the new data confirm it too.)

items.spanish: Amennyiben a gép jól működik, úgy a tudósok elkezdhetik a kísérletet.
items.english: If the machine works well, the scientists can begin the experiment.

items.spanish: A kísérletet azzal a feltétellel engedélyezték, hogy a tudósok ellenőrzik az eredményt.
items.english: The experiment was approved on the condition that the scientists check the result.

items.spanish: Abban az esetben, ha az előrejelzés igaz, a gyárak jövőre új gépeket vásárolnak.
items.english: In the event that the forecast is true, the factories will buy new machines next year.

items.spanish: A hipotézis akkor marad érvényes, ha az új adatok is igazolják.
items.english: The hypothesis stays valid if the new data confirm it too.

sections.title: B2 Stylistic Notice
sections.content: Plain *ha* is still the everyday word. *Amennyiben* and *abban az esetben, ha* sound careful and official: use them when you state a condition for a forecast or a test.
